Watch the full speech of a British MP on the floor of the House of Commons calls for an immediate suspension of Covid-19 mRNA vaccines in the United Kingdom.Show more "There needs to be an immediate and complete suspension of covid [mRNA] vaccines..Something is rotten in British medicine & has been for a long time" - Andrew Bridgen, British Member of Parliament for Northwest Leicestershire
Dr. Aseem Malhotra calls this.."the most important parliamentary speech you will see & it may save your life."
